data.text: CI on the 0.8.0 merge commit (1b9a7bf) failed once on Node 22: perf 'cold loadState reads the journal once, not twice' measured 76.3 ms against a 73.9 ms bound (1.6x a 46 ms cold loadOrBuild), best of three. The tree was byte-identical to bc2e905, green on Node 20 and 22 an hour earlier and green locally; a rerun of the failed job passed. A ratio of two single-digit-run timings on a shared runner sits close to its own margin; the test was not loosened to ship.
